Introduction

Bangalore, also known as the Silicon Valley of India, has many of the most technologically advanced and strategically planned tech parks in India; these advanced commercial spaces have helped to make the city a global IT hub. Tech parks found here range from long-established tech parks, like International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB), to more recent sustainable parks like RGA Tech Park. The tech parks offer modern infrastructure, innovative design and layouts, and are located close to transport options.  The tech parks found in Bangalore offer great opportunities for innovation, collaboration, and growth regardless of if you are a startup, or multinational corporation. Let’s look at the top IT parks in Bangalore that are reshaping the ideas of modern work.

List of Tech Parks in Bangalore 


  1. Bagmane tech park

  2. International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB)

  3.  Embassy Manyata Business Park

  4. RMZ Ecospace

  5. Prestige tech park

  6. Shilpitha tech park

  7. AKR tech park

  8. Kalyani tech park bangalore

  9. Brigade Tech park 

  10. Cessna Business Park

  11. Global Tech Village

  12. RMZ Infinity

  13. RGA Tech Park

  14. Embassy Golf Links


    1) Bagmane tech park

Bagmane Tech Park is in C.V. Raman Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560093. Developed by the Bagmane Group, and opened in 1998, Bagmane Tech Park is spread across 52 acres and has 6.5 million sq. ft. of space. It has great connectivity - about 3 km from Bayappanahalli Metro Station and 0.8 km from C.V. Raman Nagar Bus Stop, with landmarks like BEML Hospital, the Kaggadasapura Lake nearby to it. There are many top brands like Amazon, EY, Dell, HP, and Cognizant have offices in the Park, which has a modern infrastructure and environment for employees. Bagmane Tech Park is one of the better known technology hubs in East Bengaluru.


2) International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB)

International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB) was founded in January 1994, and is located at ITPL Main Rd, Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066. RSP Architects developed the design and it is now operated by CapitaLand, and it is one of the earliest and most iconic tech parks in Bengaluru. The campus includes Park Square Mall with sporting facilities and Vivanta by Taj hotel. It is connected via Pattandur Agrahara Metro Station and is located about 18 km from the main city. ITPB is home to leading tech firms such as TCS, IBM, Oracle, Wipro, Accenture and Mu Sigma, and has best-in-class infrastructure in the Whitefield IT corridor.

Working at ITPB? We’ve got cozy flats just around the corner. Stay close to work and skip the long commute.


3) Embassy Manyata Business Park

Embassy Manyata Business Park, also referred to as Manyata Tech Park, is located at Outer Ring Road, Nagavara, Hebbal, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560045. Developed by Embassy Group, the park is developed on 300 acres as per its master plan and has a built-up area of 9.8 million sq. ft. This was launched in the early 2000s and North Bangalore location commands preferred logistics and transportation access in North Bangalore via the Outer Ring Road, and it is a few kilometers away from the Kempegowda International Airport. Manyata Tech Park is known for its global giants such as IBM, Cognizant, Microsoft, and Target. It offers Grade A office space with world-class infrastructure and is the growth anchor in North Bengaluru acquisition and tech growth.


4) RMZ Ecospace

RMZ Ecospace is a well-known eco friendly technology park located at Outer Ring Road, Adarsh Palm Retreat, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103. It was conceived and developed by RMZ Corp approximately in 2012. RMZ Ecospace is situated on 25 acres of the new Central Business District of Bangalore electric market place, adjacent to Junctions of Sarjapur and Marathahalli. RMZ Ecospace signifies a strong commitment to eco-friendly, resource-efficient, and safe places to work with adherence to green architectural design principles. It provides easy access 5 km away from Bellandur Railway Station and just minutes away from iconic locations like KGA Golf Course and Square Mall. Many reputable businesses like Honeywell and KPMG have established themselves here so RMZ Ecospace is regarded as a desirable business investment providing world-class infrastructure and exemplary sustainability.


Live just minutes from RMZ Ecospace. Our nearby flats in Bellandur make your daily routine smoother and your weekends more relaxed.


5) Prestige tech park

Prestige Tech Park, constructed by the Prestige Group in 2013, lies along the Sarjapur - Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka. This Grade A office park has four phases and consists of modern day bare-shell offices and ready to occupy workspaces. Prestige Tech Park is a distance of 46 km from Kempegowda International Airport and lies next to bus stops and an upcoming metro station. The park has all the top IT companies working out of the complex in addition to power backup, parking plenty of car and bike parking, and ground level amenities typical of many corporate buildings. Prestige Tech Park is near residential buildings, malls, and food court establishments bringing together professionalism and simple convenience to make Prestige Tech Park a key IT location in East Bengaluru.


Looking for flats for rent in Marathahalli? Live close to Prestige Tech Park and make your daily commute quick and hassle-free.


6) Shilpitha Tech Park

Shilpitha Tech Park is a leading commercial development located at Outer Ring Road, Devarabisanahalli, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103 that opened in November 2018 with a development area of 3 acres and a total built up area of 364000 sq.ft. The tech park offers modern office spaces that can be customized suites to meet the IT, Start-up and Multinational firms requirements. In addition, it is well connected to neighbouring IT corridors, including Whitefield and Marathahalli with the Bellandur Bus Stop located 900 Mts away and Seetharam Palya Metro Station located 9 Kms away from the property. Shilpitha is well set with world class amenitites for the business growth.


7) AKR Tech Park

AKR Tech Park is a commercial development located in the Krishna Reddy Industrial Area along Hosur Road, Bengaluru, created by AKR Developers. Opened in 2022, the park offers 325,620 square feet of high-quality office space for the IT and corporate community. The park is home to companies like HGS, Myntra, Flipkart, and Altruist Technologies. Offering quality connectivity with a close proximity to Electronic City, Silk Board Junction, and bus stands (0.5 km), amenities on site include 24x7 security, ample parking, food courts, banking, nature zones, and more. AKR Tech Park has all the offerings needed for professionals looking for an active and ready workplace.


8) Kalyani Tech park, Bangalore

Kalyani Tech Park is developed by Kalyani Developers Pvt Ltd and it is located at Opposite Brookfield Hospital, EPIP Zone, Brookefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037. The newest tech park is in Brookefield, one of the fastest-growing locations in India with state-of-the-art office spaces with best-in-class facilities in the interior of Kalyani Platina, which opened its doors in the early 2000s, is home to brands like SAP, HP, Mphasis. The development has several green-certified buildings, sustainable infrastructure for building and a modern feel with private cabins, meeting rooms, and co-working spaces. Kalyani Tech Park is best in class in Bengaluru, with adequate connections to bus bays and good accessibility to nearby IT Hubs. The combination of convenience, environmental friendliness, and amenities has made Kalyani Tech Park the best corporate destination.


9) Brigade Tech Park:

Brigade Tech Park is located at Pattandur Agrahara Road, Whitefield, Bangalore, Karnataka 560066. Brigade Tech Park is a ready to move commercial space developed by Brigade Enterprises Ltd. Brigade Tech Park has divided into 2 blocks, both have 10 floored building, with 47000 sq. ft. per floor, Brigade Tech Park has central air-conditioning, 24.7 power backup and parking ratio of 1:1000. This tech park is launched to support modern business requirements. Brigade Tech Park has excellent connectivity via road and metro. Brigade Tech Park is 38 km away from the international airport. Brigade Tech Park is surrounded with hotels such as Vivanta by Taj, The Den etc. Major shopping malls, major banks and hotels are surrounding Brigade Tech Park, and near ITPB. Brigade Tech Park is the most desirable place in East Bangalore.


10) Cessna Business Park

Cessna Business Park is a 22 acre premium IT hub located on Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, Bangalore and was developed by Prestige Group. It was launched in 2011 and consists of 11 modern towers that accommodate premier companies like Cisco, HCL, Walmart, Sapiens and Cargill, to name a few. The park enjoys fantastic connectivity as it is very close to Kadubeesanahalli and New Horizon College bus stop, and a short drive to KR Puram Railway Station. There is also a proposed metro station coming soon, which will aid significantly in its overall accessibility. Centre has great modern amenities and is strategically located on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli stretch making it one of the most sought after corporate addresses in Bengaluru.


11) Global Village Tech Park

Sattva Global City, previously called Global Village Tech Park, is a 71.2-acre software technology park located off Mysore Road in Kengeri, Bengaluru. The park was originally developed by Café Coffee Day's Tanglin Developments, which is now owned by Sattva. The park is located just behind RV College of Engineering and is incredibly well-connected: Pattanagere Metro Station is 1 km away, Kengeri Railway Station is 4 km away, and Kengeri Bus Terminal is also nearby. The park is home to leading tech companies (including the former Mindtree HQ), and now includes 3.3 million sq. ft. of built-up space and surrounded by flourishing residential areas and good social infrastructure.


12) RMZ Infinity

RMZ Infinity, situated on Old Madras Road, Bengaluru, is a high-end commercial complex developed by RMZ Corp. It was designed by DP Architects of Singapore. It is ideally located between the Central Business District and Whitefield and is well connected—3 km from City Railway Station and 6 km from CBD. The tech park features "The Bay", where you can find cafes, fine dining, banking, and a gym. Buzzing with activity, major corporates like Google, Thomson Reuters, British Telecom, EY, and GE work from this area. With excellent infrastructure, modern amenities and high security, RMZ Infinity can be your destination of choice for global and local businesses.


13) RGA Tech Park

RGA Tech Park, found on Marathahalli-Sarjapur Road, Bangalore, is a Grade A commercial development, certified LEED Platinum by the USGBC.  The Park was developed in 2016 and totals more than 2.1 million sq. ft. with 1.18 million sq. ft. on SEZ. There were other developments happening around, as well as residential developments, making the area a prime location for business of all types. From the park, there are efficient public transport options but also arterial roads connecting to them. RGA Technology Park has wide green yards for parking, outdoor spaces, and an extensive set of amenities, parking, and security features. Leading multinational corporations have chosen to locate at RGA Technology Park because of its premium and secure infrastructure and its sustainable design achieving LEED certification, and its location at the heart of Bangalore's IT corridor.


If you’re working at RGA Tech Park, we’ve got great flats nearby. Convenient, comfortable, and just a short ride away. Do check them out.


14) Embassy GolfLinks Business Park

Embassy GolfLinks Business Park, developed by Embassy Group and currently owned by Embassy REIT, is situated off Intermediate Ring Road close to Domlur next to the beautiful Karnataka Golf Association (KGA) Golf Course. Embassy GolfLinks is spread over 37.11 acres and is home to 3.1 million sq. ft. of fully leased operational space. Embassy GolfLinks is award-winning and opened in 2004, is highly connected (7 km from Bangalore's CBD, and 5 km from Indiranagar Metro) and has top-end amenity spaces including food courts, amphitheater, and eco-friendly structure.  Top tenants include Facebook, JP Morgan, IBM, Dell, Salesforce and Goldman Sachs, and is undoubtedly one of the most prestigious business parks in Bengaluru.


Conclusion


The tech parks in Bangalore are more than just office parks: they are healthy ecosystems driving the innovation and economic growth in the city. With world-class standards for infrastructural components, eco-friendliness, and strategic locations, tech parks provide enabling infrastructure for global companies and startups to meet their agile needs. Whether it be the engaging community feel in Manyata Tech Park or the memorable Neutrality of the parklands that surround Embassy GolfLinks, tech parks emplace humanity at a point of significance that legally fabricates Bangalore, the Silicon Valley of India. As Bangalore builds its IT brand and expands, tech parks will be an integral part of India's digital transformation strategy.
